# Implementation Plan: Core Foundation — Logging & Assertions

**Branch**: `005-core-logging-assertions` | **Date**: 2026-05-13 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/005-core-logging-assertions/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command.

## Summary

Implement the Core layer's diagnostic infrastructure: a severity-based logging system (`SG_LOG` macro with category filtering and console output) and assertion macros (`SG_CHECK`, `SG_VERIFY`, `SG_CHECKF`) with platform-specific debugger break support. The design uses macro-level early-out for zero-overhead filtered messages, `std::mutex` for thread-safe atomic log output, and platform-conditional debug break intrinsics for cross-platform assertion/fatal behavior. All code lives in `Source/Core` with no dependencies on higher layers.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C++20 (traditional header/source separation; no C++20 Modules)
**Primary Dependencies**: C++ standard library only (`<cstdio>`, `<cstdarg>`, `<mutex>`, `<chrono>`, `<cstdlib>`); SCons 4.10.1 build system
**Storage**: N/A (runtime diagnostic infrastructure; no persistent storage)
**Testing**: Existing SCons-built `StonerTest` executable with self-contained verification code
**Target Platform**: Windows (MSVC), macOS (Apple Clang/Clang), Linux (GCC/Clang)
**Project Type**: Static library feature in the engine Core layer
**Performance Goals**: Filtered-out `SG_LOG` messages cost at most one integer comparison (no formatting, no function call). `SG_CHECK` in Release builds is completely compiled out (zero cost).
**Constraints**: Core must not include RHI, Backend, Renderer, or Application; no graphics API dependencies; public names must follow UE5-style prefixes; thread-safe log output using `std::mutex` as interim solution; printf-style formatting (not `std::format`)
**Scale/Scope**: 5 key entities (`ELogSeverity`, `FLogCategory`, `FLog`, `FLogConsoleSink`, assertion macros) plus 5 pre-defined categories and comprehensive unit test coverage

## Phase 0 Research Summary

Research decisions are recorded in [research.md](./research.md):

- Use a macro-level severity check for early-out filtering (single integer comparison, no function call for filtered messages).
- Use `snprintf` for printf-style formatting with a fixed stack buffer (1024 bytes) to avoid heap allocation in the common case.
- Use `std::mutex` for thread-safe log output as an interim solution (no custom threading library yet).
- Use platform-conditional `SG_DEBUG_BREAK()` macro wrapping `__debugbreak()` / `__builtin_debugtrap()`.
- Use static self-registration pattern for log categories (constructor-based auto-registration into a global registry).
- Use `_DEBUG` / `NDEBUG` defines (already set by BuildConfig.py) to control assertion compilation.
- Console sink writes to `stdout` for Verbose/Info and `stderr` for Warning/Error/Fatal.
